claims.text: The resort is on a private island in Shaviyani Atoll.

findings.quote: a tropical island paradise situated on a private island in Shaviyani Atoll

claims.text: Accommodation is in overwater villas and beach villas with private pools and decks overlooking the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: stylish overwater villas and beach villas with plush bedding, private pools and decks with stunning views of the shimmering Indian Ocean

claims.text: Each villa terrace has a private wooden deck, a pool and an outdoor shower.

findings.quote: from your private villa terrace with its own spacious private wooden deck, pool and outdoor shower

claims.text: The Duplex Overwater Pool Villa has an infinity pool and lets guests snorkel right from the villa.

findings.quote: This exquisite retreat features a stunning infinity pool and direct access to the vibrant marine life, allowing you to snorkel right from your villa.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Duplex Beach Pool Villa has direct beach access and personal Thakuru (butler) service.

findings.quote: With direct beach access, your personal Thakuru (butler) service

claims.text: Spa by JW treatments are inspired by four benefit states: Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew.

findings.quote: each treatment is inspired by four benefit states — Calm, Indulge, Invigorate, and Renew

claims.text: Spa by JW uses products from Aromatherapy Associates.

findings.quote: we elevate every treatment with the finest products from Aromatherapy Associates

claims.text: The spa's Island Touch is a 120-minute treatment for two in the deluxe spa suite, with access to the couple's steam bath and ice room.

findings.quote: Create your perfect island escape with our Island Touch treatment, a personalized 120-minute journey for two.
Unwind side by side in our deluxe spa suite, enjoying exclusive access to the couple’s steam bath and ice room—120 minutes of shared serenity and rejuvenation.

claims.text: Activities include snorkeling, scuba diving, jet-skiing and sailing.

findings.quote: Discover a wide variety of activities, including snorkeling, scuba diving, jet-skiing and sailing.

claims.text: The Dive & Water Sports Center offers kitesurfing, parasailing, kayaking and paddle boarding.

findings.quote: a host of activities at the Dive & Water Sports Center such as kitesurfing, parasailing, kayaking, and paddle boarding

claims.text: Kaashi is a Thai restaurant set in a treetop location with views of the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: Enjoy a unique Thai dining experience at our beachfront restaurant in the Maldives, set in a stunning treetop location. Take in panoramic views of the Indian Ocean

claims.text: Hashi is a Japanese teppanyaki restaurant in an overwater location.

findings.quote: as you witness our talented teppanyaki chefs showcase their skills in the Maldives. Our Hashi restaurant features classic Japanese décor amid an overwater location.

claims.text: Spa by JW is an overwater spa set above the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: SPA by JW is a refined sanctuary set above the Indian Ocean

claims.text: The villas' thatched roofs recall upside-down Dhoni boats, the traditional wooden fishing vessels of the Maldives, and the slanted roof tips recall white herons dipping their heads into the water.

findings.quote: Thatched roofs on villas are reminiscent of upside-down Dhoni boats, the traditional wooden fishing vessels of Maldives, and slanted roof tips recall white herons dipping their heads into the water.

claims.text: The Duplex Overwater Pool Villas have a master bedroom and an upstairs lounge with views of the Laccadive Sea.

findings.quote: The Duplex Overwater Pool Villas feature a spacious master bedroom and an upstairs lounge with breathtaking views of the Laccadive Sea

claims.text: The Little Griffins Kids' Club has a pirate ship and more than 100 activities, from treasure hunts and snorkeling to arts, sports and science experiments.

findings.quote: Little Griffins Kids' Club is a paradise for young adventurers, featuring a pirate ship and 100+ fun activities, from treasure hunts and snorkeling to arts, sports, and science experiments.

claims.text: The resort has an open-air overwater yoga pavilion.

findings.quote: Open-air overwater yoga pavilion.

claims.text: The resort runs on Island Time, an hour ahead of the capital, Male.

findings.quote: Experience meaningful moments together with family and loved ones with an extra hour of daylight each day during your stay
The resort’s time zone is an hour ahead of the capital, Male’. Maldives Time (GMT +5) - Island Time (GMT +6)

claims.text: Velana International Airport is about 192 km from the resort.

findings.quote: The closest airport near JW Marriott Maldives Resort & Spa is Velana International Airport (MLE). MLE is located approximately 192.0 KM from the hotel.

claims.text: Spa by JW requires an appointment and does not take online reservations.

findings.quote: An appointment is required at Spa by JW.
Online reservations are not available for Spa by JW.
